Explore Gulf Conferences' 2026–2027 student recruitment exhibitions across the Middle East and Africa.
GULF CONFERENCES
International Student Recruitment Exhibitions
2026–2027 EXHIBITION CALENDAR

Connect with students across the Middle East and Africa

Dear Colleague,

I hope you are well. I am reaching out from Gulf Conferences to invite your institution to explore participation in our upcoming international student recruitment exhibitions across Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Iraq, Morocco and Nigeria.

Gulf Conferences is a UK-based international education events and recruitment organisation established in 2009, with a regional office in Saudi Arabia. We work directly with universities, schools, counsellors, students, parents, education authorities, scholarship bodies, agents and institutional partners across the Middle East and Africa.

Autumn 2026
Dammam, Saudi Arabia
7–8 October 2026
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
12–13 October 2026
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
17–18 October 2026
Doha, Qatar
22–23 October 2026
Baghdad, Iraq
29–30 October 2026
Rabat, Morocco
7 November 2026
Casablanca, Morocco
8 November 2026
Lagos, Nigeria
25–27 November 2026
  
Spring 2027
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
17–18 February 2027
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
20–21 February 2027
Abha, Saudi Arabia
23–24 February 2027
Lagos, Nigeria
14–15 March 2027
Doha, Qatar
22–23 March 2027
Casablanca, Morocco
26–29 March 2027
Rabat, Morocco
31 March–1 April 2027
Participation provides
• Direct engagement with prospective undergraduate and postgraduate students
• Invitations and outreach to schools and counsellors
• Targeted digital and social media promotion
• Visa invitation support where required
• Post-event access to registered student data

Further information about the exhibition formats, visitor profiles, school engagement and previous event results is available below.

We would be pleased to learn more about your institution's recruitment priorities and discuss the most suitable markets and participation options. Please reply to this email or select a convenient meeting time using the link above.
